status.d: Major Industrial is a permitted use in IH, which is where the City says large-scale data centres belong.
status.env: Height 30.0 m (the City may vary it for operating features). Floor area up to 2.0 × the lot. Minimum site 1.0 ha. Street setback 3.0 m.

cl: Major Industrial Permitted; Minor Industrial only where existing on 1 Jan 2024, so a small data centre fits only if deemed Major (?); always Discretionary
30.0 m; the City may vary it for operating features
3.0 m from a street; minimum site 1.0 ha
ventilating equipment, plumbing stacks and mechanical penthouses are not counted in height

notes: Noise: needs 8 low-noise chillers: Trane RTAF 280 low-noise, Lw 98 dBA per 1,010 kW, 101 standard (maker claim, traneRTAF). Drawn as the basis unit: its size is not in the register (?); and a 4.9 m solid screen around the roof and yard plant, no gaps, ≥ 20 kg/m²: −8 dB, NSW 2021 method (arch_nz_nswDcNoise), never more than FHWA's line-of-sight rule gives (arch_nz_fhwaNBDH). Taller than the units, so EVAPCO's wall rule needs more space or the maker's approval (?). Without it: about 66–69 dBA (quieter–standard unit rating) at the property line of 12311 126 AVENUE NW (IH), 54 m away; limit 60 dBA…

Noise: the plant would exceed the 50 dBA night limit at the property line of (no parcel record: residential limit assumed ?) (about 52 dBA (low-noise units: one rating) with low-noise chillers (Trane RTAF 280 LN, maker claim) + a 4.9 m solid screen (roof and yard; NSW 2021, −8 dB), Bylaw 14600 s. 20(1)) if that lot takes the stricter limit; its zoning is not known, so this is a note, not a block.

loadingNeed.basis: 1 loading space for 2,913 m² of floor area (Table 7.2). Each 9.0 × 3.0–3.3 m, 4.0 m clear, wholly on site, with no backing onto streets or alleys (s. 5.80 subs. 7). Aisle: Vancouver's 6.1 m used as an assumption.

s.src: Air-cooled chillers with free-cooling coils (air cooling): an air-cooled hall needs chilled water at about 13 °C or warmer (NREL for DOE FEMP, Best Practices Guide 2024, s. 5.2.1), and a dry cooler cannot cool water below the outdoor air (rated units leave it 3–11 K above), so chillers carry the full load in summer. Basis unit: Vertiv Liebert AFC FIZ135, 12.14 × 2.36 m, 2.90 m high, 1,489 kW at 35 °C ambient, 27.8 → 18.9 °C fluid, 30% glycol, with oversized free-cooling coils (Vertiv SL-71060 R09/24, "Preliminary data"; manufacturer claim). Chosen 29 Oct 2026 as the unit nearest the middle of …

lines: Sized for 3.8 MW of servers: heat to reject ≈ 3.8 × PUE 1.55 = 5.9 MW at peak.
4 air-cooled chillers carry it; with spares, 5. Placed: 3 on the roof, 2 in the yard.
Each unit about 12.141 × 2.362 m, 2.896 m high, with 0.9–2.1 m to walls and 1.8–4.3 m between units (dashed in 3D).

genLines: 3 generator sets of about 2 MW carry 5.9 MW; with spares, 4. Placed: 0 on the roof, 4 in the yard.
Each about 13.493 × 3.488 m, 4.777 m high; 1.5 m from the building, 2 m between sets (1 m clear all round, CSA C282 6.5.1.1; register arch_csa_c282).

Fuel in each set's sub-base tank: about 6200 L. In the yard: 3 m from the property line and 1.5 m from the building (CSA B139.1.0 Table 2; register arch_csa_b139). On a roof: at most 1,250 L a tank and 2,500 L a supply line (B139.1.1 6.5.3). FM 5-32 (insurer guidance, not law): not on the roof or in a basement.

<span class="src">Standby diesel generator sets in Sound Level 2 enclosures with sub-base tanks. Basis units: Rehlko (Kohler) KD2000, 2,000 kW standby (data-centre continuous rating the same), 13.49 × 3.49 m, up to 4.78 m high (G5-626, rev 6/24); KD1000, 1,000 kW, 8.43 × 2.62 m, 3.71 m high with the 12 h tank (G6-154, 12/23). Both EPA Tier 2, cULus (UL 2200, CSA C22.2 No. 100); manufacturer claims. Chosen 29 Oct 2026 as the middle of Cat, Rehlko and Generac: 2 MW 18.5–38.4 m² per MW, 1 MW 19.5–22.4. 1 m clear around each set (Cummins application manual; not checked ?); 1.5 m from wall openings…
